resources.string: Take a breath before you scroll. A second of air is enough to choose what really matters.
The accessibility service is off, so SegundoAire can\'t detect when you open a watched app. Turn it back on.
The permission to display over other apps is off, so the pause can\'t be shown. Turn it back on.
Detects which app is opening so SegundoAire can give you a moment to breathe. Everything stays on your device.
One small step to protect your time
To show a gentle pause before distracting apps open, SegundoAire needs permission to display over other apps. It only appears when you open an app you chose, and nothing leaves your device.
Do you really want to go in here right now?
